args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Issue:** The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all three regions. (No change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production release.)
2. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and confirmation of recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommendation: hold off on re-deploying v2.3.1 until the root cause of the health-check failures is investigated.
